benefit_text: The scheme gives a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1000, Rs. 2000, Rs. 3000, Rs. 4000 or Rs. 5000 per month after age 60 until death. The spouse receives the same pension after the subscriber’s death. The nominee gets the accumulated pension wealth after both die.
who_can_apply: People aged 18 to 40 can join. There is no income requirement. Citizens who are or have been income tax payers are not eligible.
documents: Active bank or post office savings account for KYC, Aadhaar for identity verification, and Aadhaar virtual ID or XML file for KYC upload.
how_to_apply: Visit the eNPS website and select Atal Pension Yojana. Fill basic and nominee details, choose the pension amount and contribution frequency, give consent for auto‑debit, and complete Aadhaar KYC by OTP or uploading the XML/Virtual ID.
